verdict.rationale: Apple's docs say Siri AI accepts natural-language requests: open-ended conversation, drafting from a description in your own words, and taking actions in apps like Messages, Music and Reminders. Spotlight can also take action and route to 'Ask Siri'. The documented actions cover named apps and on-screen context rather than operating the OS as a whole, and every claim is vendor marketing. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands cover system-wide OS operations (settings, files, windows) beyond the listed apps, documented scope and limits of supported actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Siri AI can take actions in apps like Messages, Music, Reminders, and more based on what you’re doing in the moment.
Just describe what you need in your own words.
Just take a screenshot of what’s on your display, like an image or a PDF, to get answers, search, or take action.
And when you search in Spotlight, you can choose “Ask Siri” as the top hit.
